title: Vercise™ DBS Dystonia Prospective Study
official: Prospective Study of Deep Brain Stimulation With the VERCISE™ System for Treatment of Dystonia
summary: To compile characteristics of real-world outcomes of Boston Scientific Corporation's commercially approved VerciseTM Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) Systems for the treatment of dystonia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria (IC):

* IC1. Meets criteria established in the locally applicable Vercise System Directions for Use (DFU) for dystonia.
* IC2. At least 7 years old. Parent or guardian consent is required in patients who are younger than 18 years at the time of consent.

Exclusion Criteria (EC):

* EC1. Meets any contraindication in the Vercise System locally applicable Directions for Use.

sites.f: Queen Elizabeth II Health Sciences Center
